title: 提出量子假说 (黑体辐射)

video.title: 普朗克常数与黑体辐射
video.title_en: Blackbody Radiation and the Ultraviolet Catastrophe

summary.text: 马克斯·普朗克（Max Planck）为了解决“黑体辐射”问题（特别是“紫外灾难”），提出了一个革命性的假说。他假设，能量的释放和吸收不是连续的，而是以不连续的“能量包”或“量子”(Quanta) 的形式进行的。他提出了一个连接能量(E)和频率(f)的公式：E = hf，其中 h 是一个极小的基本常数，即“普朗克常数”。这被认为是“量子力学”的诞生日。
summary.text_en: To solve the 'black-body radiation' problem (specifically the 'ultraviolet catastrophe'), Max Planck proposed a revolutionary hypothesis. He assumed that energy was not emitted or absorbed continuously, but in discrete 'packets' or 'quanta'. He introduced the formula E = hf, relating energy (E) to frequency (f) via a new fundamental constant, 'h', known as Planck's constant. This event is considered the birth of quantum mechanics.
key_points: 量子力学的诞生 (Birth of Quantum Mechanics)
提出了 E = hf (普朗克公式)

story.text: 在1900年，经典物理学（牛顿和麦克斯韦）在解释“黑体”（完美吸收和辐射所有光的热体）如何发光时，遭遇了巨大失败。经典理论预测，黑体在紫外线波段将释放出“无限”的能量，这显然是荒谬的，被称为“紫外灾难”。普朗克在1900年底，作为“一个绝望的举动”，尝试了一个数学“技巧”：他假设能量只能像“整数包”一样一份一份地发出（如 1hf, 2hf, 3hf...）。令他自己都感到惊讶的是，这个激进的假设（能量不连续）所推导出的公式，与所有实验数据完美吻合。他并不清楚这在物理上意味着什么，但他已经打开了量子世界的大门。
story.text_en: In 1900, classical physics (Newton's and Maxwell's laws) failed spectacularly to explain how a 'black-body' (a perfect absorber/emitter of light) radiates heat. Classical theory predicted *infinite* energy would be radiated in the ultraviolet frequencies—an absurdity known as the 'ultraviolet catastrophe'. In late 1900, as 'an act of desperation', Planck tried a mathematical 'trick': he assumed energy could only be emitted in discrete packets, or 'quanta' (like 1hf, 2hf, 3hf...). To his own surprise, the formula this assumption produced *perfectly* matched all the experimental data. He didn't fully understand the physical implications, but he had just unlocked the door to the quantum world.

fun_facts.text: 普朗克本人最初并不相信他自己的理论。他认为“量子化”只是一个暂时的数学工具，并试图在接下来的几年里将其“修复”，使其回归经典物理学，但失败了。
fun_facts.text_en: Planck himself didn't believe his own theory at first. He considered 'quantization' a temporary mathematical tool and spent the next several years trying (and failing) to 'fix' it to fit classical physics.

fun_facts.text: 正是阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦（Albert Einstein）在1905年（`einstein_photoelectric_1905`）第一个“严肃地”对待了普朗克的量子概念，并提出光本身就是由这些量子（“光子”）组成的，从而解释了光电效应。
fun_facts.text_en: It was Albert Einstein in 1905 (`einstein_photoelectric_1905`) who first took Planck's quantum concept *seriously* as a physical reality, proposing that light *itself* is made of these quanta ('photons') to explain the photoelectric effect.

simple_explanation.text:
想象一下，经典物理学认为能量就像一条“光滑的斜坡”：你可以拥有任意数量的能量，比如1.1、1.2、1.25... 
而普朗克则说：“不对，能量更像是一排‘楼梯’。” 你可以站在第1级台阶，或者第2级台阶，但你永远不能站在“第1.5级台阶”。你只能以“一整包”（量子）的形式获得或失去能量。这个看似微小的“台阶”概念，就是整个量子革命的开端。
simple_explanation.text_en:
Imagine classical physics thought energy was a smooth 'ramp'. You could have any amount of energy, like 1.1, 1.2, 1.25... 
Planck came along and said, 'No, energy is a 'staircase'.' You can be on Step 1, or Step 2, but *never* on Step 1.5. You can only gain or lose energy in 'packets', or 'quanta'. This simple idea of 'steps' (quantization) was the start of the entire quantum revolution.

applications.title: 光电效应 (Photoelectric Effect)
applications.text: 爱因斯坦立即使用了普朗克的 E = hf 公式来解释光电效应（`einstein_photoelectric_1905`），并因此获得了诺贝尔奖。
applications.text_en: Einstein immediately used Planck's E = hf formula to explain the photoelectric effect (`einstein_photoelectric_1905`), for which he won the Nobel Prize.

applications.title: 原子模型 (Atomic Model)
applications.text: 尼尔斯·玻尔（Niels Bohr）在1913年（`bohr_atom_1913`）提出，电子的轨道也是“量子化”的，它们通过“跃迁”来吸收或释放普朗克的“能量包”（光子）。
applications.text_en: Niels Bohr (in 1913, `bohr_atom_1913`) proposed that electron orbits were *also* quantized, and they 'jumped' between orbits by absorbing or emitting Planck's 'energy packets' (photons).

applications.title: 所有现代电子学
applications.text: 量子力学（由普朗克开启）是理解半导体和晶体管（计算机芯片的基础）如何工作的唯一理论。
applications.text_en: Quantum mechanics (which Planck started) is the only theory that explains how semiconductors and transistors—the basis of every computer chip—work.

impact.text: 普朗克的量子假说是“经典物理学”时代的终结，和“现代物理学”时代的开启。它引入了“不连续性”和“概率性”作为宇宙的基本特征，与牛顿的“连续”和“确定性”宇宙观形成了根本性的决裂。20世纪的所有物理学——从原子到宇宙学——都建立在普朗克在1900年点燃的这场革命之上。
impact.text_en: Planck's hypothesis was the 'end' of classical physics and the 'beginning' of modern physics. It introduced discontinuity and probability as fundamental features of the universe, a radical break from Newton's continuous and deterministic cosmos. All of 20th-century physics, from atoms to cosmology, is built on the revolution Planck started in 1900.

influenced_by.contribution: 玻尔兹曼（其“统计力学”的方法启发了普朗克使用统计方法来描述能量分布）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Boltzmann (his methods in 'statistical mechanics' inspired Planck to use statistics to describe energy distribution)

influenced_by.contribution: 卢默尔和普林斯海姆（其“黑体辐射”的精确实验数据是普朗克试图在理论上匹配的）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Lummer & Pringsheim (their precise experimental data on black-body radiation was what Planck's theory had to match)

influenced.contribution: 爱因斯坦（其“光电效应”是将普朗克的“量子”从数学假说转变为物理现实的第一步）
influenced.contribution_en: Einstein (his 'photoelectric effect' was the first step in taking Planck's 'quanta' from a mathematical hypothesis to a physical reality)

influenced.contribution: 尼尔斯·玻尔（将其“量子化”思想应用于原子结构）
influenced.contribution_en: Niels Bohr (applied the 'quantization' idea to the structure of the atom)

influenced.contribution: 薛定谔（其“波动力学”是普朗克量子假说的最终数学形式）
influenced.contribution_en: Schrödinger (his 'wave mechanics' was the final mathematical formulation of Planck's quantum hypothesis)

influence_chain.legacy_text: 马克斯·普朗克违背了自己的所有经典物理直觉，极不情愿地开启了量子革命。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: Max Planck, against all his own classical instincts, reluctantly started the quantum revolution.

quiz.question: 马克斯·普朗克（Max Planck）在1900年提出他的“量子假说”是为了解决哪个物理学难题？
quiz.question_en: What problem in physics was Max Planck trying to solve when he proposed his 'quantum hypothesis' in 1900?
quiz.explanation: “紫外灾难”是经典物理学的著名失败，它错误地预测一个热物体会释放出无限的紫外线能量。普朗克的“量子化”假说（能量不连续）完美地解决了这个矛盾。
quiz.explanation_en: The 'Ultraviolet Catastrophe' was the famous failure of classical physics to predict black-body radiation (it wrongly predicted infinite energy). Planck's 'quantization' hypothesis (that energy is not continuous) fixed this.
